chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Abdullah ibn Aamir, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Al-Husayn ibn Saeed, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, who said:

I asked Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about the woman who embraces her husband from behind, so she moves upon his back, and desire comes to her, and she discharges water; is the ritual bath obligatory upon her or not? He (peace be upon him) said: When desire comes to her and she discharges water, the ritual bath becomes obligatory upon her.
ai.seo_question: Does a woman need to perform ghusl if she discharges fluid during foreplay?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi clarifies that the discharge of *madh* (pre-seminal fluid) during foreplay, such as embracing, obligates the minor ritual bath (*ghusl al-madh*) for women, aligning with the Shia view that any sexual fluid discharge due to desire requires purification. It distinguishes this ruling from *mani* (seminal fluid) which requires the major bath, highlighting the jurisprudential nuance in distinguishing between types of sexual fluids and their respective purification requirements in Shia fiqh.
